metrics.name: eligible ready-subject learner count
metrics.extraction: Count distinct learners with ready-subject state rows; final launchability still requires smoke proof.

metrics.name: exposed account count
metrics.extraction: Count distinct actor accounts from Hero telemetry and linked accounts for learners with Hero state.

metrics.name: Hero Quest shown count
metrics.extraction: Requires client render telemetry or browser-smoke evidence; do not infer from registry presence.

metrics.name: Hero Quest start count
metrics.extraction: Count learner-days where Hero progress has firstStartedAt or at least one task started/completed.

metrics.name: Hero task start count
metrics.extraction: Count Hero tasks with status started or completed in the authoritative progress JSON.

metrics.name: Hero task completion count
metrics.extraction: Count event_log rows where system_id='hero-mode' and event_type='hero.task.completed'.

metrics.name: daily Hero Quest completion count
metrics.extraction: Use child_game_state daily.status=completed as authority, with event_log daily.completed as telemetry mirror.

metrics.name: claim success count
metrics.extraction: Current server mirror records successful claims as hero.task.completed events.

metrics.name: claim rejection count
metrics.extraction: Current rejection paths are not persisted in a queryable production table.

metrics.name: coin award count
metrics.extraction: Count economy.ledger entries with type=daily-completion-award in Hero progress JSON.

metrics.name: Camp open count
metrics.extraction: Camp screen opens are client-side only unless instrumented separately.

metrics.name: Camp invite/grow count
metrics.extraction: Use economy spending ledger and Hero Pool state as authority; use camp events as telemetry mirror.

metrics.name: Hero route 4xx count
metrics.extraction: Requires Workers request logs or explicit persisted route-error telemetry.

metrics.name: Hero route 5xx count
metrics.extraction: Requires Workers request logs or explicit persisted route-error telemetry.

metrics.name: start rate from shown
metrics.extraction: The shown denominator requires client render telemetry. Use server-started counts only as a narrower decision substitute.

metrics.name: completion rate from server-started learner-days
metrics.extraction: daily.status=completed divided by learner-days with firstStartedAt or started/completed tasks.

metrics.name: next-day return rate
metrics.extraction: Approximate from distinct learner-date pairs in Hero telemetry.

metrics.name: subject mix distribution
metrics.extraction: Count subject_id on hero.task.completed telemetry rows.

metrics.name: task-intent mix
metrics.extraction: Count current Hero task intent values in authoritative progress JSON.

metrics.name: abandonment point distribution
metrics.extraction: Requires client/session instrumentation beyond current Hero state and event mirror.

metrics.name: parent/support confusion reports
metrics.extraction: Count support-log rows in category=comprehension.

metrics.name: Camp-before-learning ratio
metrics.extraction: Compare camp telemetry timestamps with daily.completed telemetry for the same learner-date.

metrics.name: extra subject practice after daily coin cap
metrics.extraction: Count task.completed telemetry after daily.completed for the same learner-date.

metrics.name: warning-condition count
metrics.extraction: Derived from computed A6 warning checks plus manual support-log thresholds.

metrics.name: duplicate daily award
metrics.extraction: Group daily-completion-award ledger entries by learner/date/quest/idempotency key.

metrics.name: duplicate Camp debit
metrics.extraction: Group monster-invite and monster-grow ledger entries by learner/idempotency key.

metrics.name: negative balance
metrics.extraction: Inspect economy.balance and ledger balanceAfter values in Hero progress JSON; malformed Hero state fails closed as an inspection failure.

metrics.name: dead CTA
metrics.extraction: Requires browser smoke or client instrumentation because dead navigation is not persisted.

metrics.name: claim without Worker-verified completion
metrics.extraction: Compare daily-award ledger entries with daily completion state and telemetry.

metrics.name: raw child content
metrics.extraction: Run recursive privacy validation against event_json payloads; fail closed on malformed, missing, or non-object payloads.

metrics.name: subject Star/mastery drift attributable to Hero Mode
metrics.extraction: Requires pre/post child_subject_state snapshots across the rollout window.

metrics.name: exposure to excluded accounts
metrics.extraction: Requires resolver classification export or named smoke accounts; do not infer from event presence alone.

metrics.name: rollback failure
metrics.extraction: Recorded by rollback rehearsal evidence, not by normal Hero state rows.

metrics.name: production 5xx spike attributable to Hero
metrics.extraction: Requires Workers request logs or explicit persisted route-error telemetry.
